purpose: Teach: ワークス/昨年度/前記/隻/女史/船長/無職/北東

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室のワークスペースを整えろ
lines.en: Ren — clean up and organize the lab workspace.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Measured delivery. The tone of someone who expects competence and sees potential. A pause before the name — eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。昨年度の研究成果を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize last year's research findings.
lines.style: Quick agreement. Slight nervousness in the intake breath before speaking. Eager to show capability. Respectful posture in the voice — not fawning, just genuinely attentive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、前記の参考文献を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — verify those references we mentioned.
lines.style: Casual precision. Not a question, but not cold either. The confidence of someone used to being understood. Slight forward lean in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究船一隻に乗船してデータを取ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll board the research vessel and collect the field data.
lines.style: Calm acceptance. A small pause between acceptance and explanation, like he's already mentally shifting gears. Focused but not tense.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、女史的な指導教員から学べ
lines.en: Ren — learn from your faculty advisor. She has good instincts.
lines.style: Quieter than the previous instructions. Almost conversational. The shift from task to mentorship — gentler opening, more measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。船長役の研究リーダーを目指します
lines.en: I will. I want to become the kind of research leader she is.
lines.style: Sincere and without irony. A slight lift on the final phrase — not aspiration exactly, but genuine respect. Careful pronunciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究期間中の無職期間も気にするな
lines.en: Ren — don't worry about gaps in employment during the research period.
lines.style: Softer opening. An almost paternal tone, but still professional. This is Hiroshi at his most human — reassurance delivered without drawing attention to it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。北東地方の研究施設も訪ねます
lines.en: Understood. I'll visit the northeast research facilities as well.
lines.style: Strong closing commitment. Steady pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone absorbing permission and transforming it into action. Slight emphasis on 'also' — showing initiative.
